documentation_proposal: The default HTML-plan workflow keeps upstream --execute/--max-characters, selected --batches, nb/no discovery, markup/link protection and separate google/<locale>/runs outputs. Its existing payloads and paid-cache fingerprints are unchanged.

For blank-fill dry runs, pass --mode blank-fill explicitly; --run, --pilot, --limit or --surface also select this workflow. --run makes paid text/plain requests and fills only blank variants, preserving reviewed values and source-format contracts.

Both paid workflows share the kit google-budget.json ledger, a US$9 maximum at US$20/million with no free-credit assumption, fsynced reservations before dispatch, an exclusive kit writer lock, and an additional ledger lock/reload for direct Budget/fetch callers. Uncertain/authentication retries each reserve their own attempt.

Historical upstream attempt files are adopted once into the campaign ledger without rewriting old caches or losing prior spend. HTML invalid-response retries remain explicit and preserve rejected output; text/plain rejects preserve raw evidence and valid siblings.

All disk text reads use UTF-8; the subprocess regression exercises both workflows under a real ASCII default locale. Tokens are obtained using gcloud subprocess argv, kept in memory briefly and omitted from evidence.

Low-level callers may use Budget(explicit_campaign_path, project, ceiling)+fetch(..., explicit_cache, budget) under the campaign root kit_lock when a refreshed source kit must continue an older campaign. Atomic replace means a symlink is not a substitute for an explicit ledger path.

HTML-plan mode explicitly rejects physical LF/CR/tab source characters before dispatch; use --mode blank-fill for exact segmented multiline/control preservation. Existing unaffected HTML payloads and paid cache keys remain unchanged.

commands.blank_fill_dry_run: python3 tools/localization/google_draft.py --output artifacts/my-kit --locale mr --project PROJECT --mode blank-fill --budget-usd 9
commands.blank_fill_paid: python3 tools/localization/google_draft.py --output artifacts/my-kit --locale mr --project PROJECT --mode blank-fill --budget-usd 9 --run

scope: Only the two assigned conflict files staged; no docs, catalogs, gates or native builds changed.
